messages.text: Hey, I'm Sarah! At about sixteen cents the Magic Miner 40T costs around $75 a month to run. It's $799, and it draws for a full block every ten minutes. Would it run on a desk, or somewhere out of the way? Tap an answer, or the mic and tell me.
Looked up for Sarah: 40T is ~50 dB in Eco, 33x16.5x19 cm desktop tower — fine for an office; Eco runs 30 TH/s at 450W, about $52 a month at 16¢.
On a desk it'll run fine. Just know that 650 watts puts out heat like a small space heater, which is nice in winter. Is this your first miner? (The call ended. 1 shopper turn(s). Reply NOTHING.)
